name: Hurricane Ian

steps.label: −48h · Forecast
steps.narrative: Forecast: Ian rapidly intensifying. Track shifts toward Southwest Florida.

steps.label: −24h · Forecast
steps.narrative: Forecast: Category 4 landfall likely. Life-threatening storm surge for Lee County.

steps.label: −12h · Forecast
steps.narrative: Final window: shutters, barriers, move equipment, pre-book contractors.

steps.label: 0h · Impact
steps.narrative: Impact: catastrophic surge on Fort Myers Beach. Hurricane-force winds inland.

steps.label: +12h · Impact
steps.narrative: Peak surge and wind. Widespread outages.

steps.label: +48h · Recovery
steps.narrative: Surge recedes. Barrier islands cut off.

steps.label: +7d · Recovery
steps.narrative: Recovery: long rebuilds on the islands. Inland sites reopen.
